data.action: 仰靠在长椅上享受午后阳光，嘴角带着惬意微笑
data.description: 午后阳光洒满公园的木质长椅上，能天使双臂枕在脑后仰靠在椅背上，惬意地享受着暖阳与微风，嘴角噙着无忧无虑的灿烂微笑——「偶尔像这样什么也不思考、只晒晒太阳发呆，感觉灵魂都被充满电了呢。老板，今天就准我放半天假吧！」
data.promptProse: Sprawled comfortably across a sun-warmed wooden bench in a quiet Lungmen park on a bright afternoon, Exusiai leans back in her hooded Penguin Logistics jacket with both hands clasped behind her head. Closing her eyes with a carefree, beaming grin, she soaks up the warm breeze beneath swaying park foliage. Dappled afternoon sunlight filters through the leafy canopy across her red tie, jacket sleeves, and the slatted bench.
data.title: 能天使 · 长椅小憩
data.animaCaption: Leaning back across the sun-warmed wooden park bench with both hands clasped behind her head, Exusiai smiles carefree into the afternoon breeze. Dappled sunlight through the overhead trees warms her Penguin Logistics jacket and face.
